metaTitle: Custom Full Color Yardsticks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color yardsticks with your logo. Great for promotions, graduations, and events. Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color yardsticks let you display detailed logos, photos, or gradients across the entire ruler. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color gives you photographic quality on durable wood or plastic. They work well for school graduations, real estate giveaways, or trade show promotions where your artwork needs to stand out. Choose from horizontal or vertical layouts to match your design.
heroAltText: Custom full color yardsticks with printed logos and artwork on wood, ideal for promotional giveaways
